verdict.rationale: Aider is documented as a terminal CLI with an experimental browser UI. The evidence shows no desktop app, no visual diff review, and no side-by-side sessions. Its change review runs through git commits and history, which is an adjacent workaround rather than the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
